title: Euge! Euge!
html_source:
This is a Latin interjection meaning Well done! Well done!

It is used mockingly here.

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: Not Latin but Greek

anchor.prefix: You were going to do wonders, what? Missionary to Europe after fiery Columbanus. Fiacre and Scotus on their creepystools in heaven spilt from their pintpots, loudlatinlaughing:
anchor.suffix: Pretending to speak broken English as you dragged your valise, porter threepence, across the slimy pier at Newhaven. Comment? Rich booty you brought back; Le Tutu, five 1939#33tat
